user.title: Photography Events
user.description: Nothing here is required to start. Open-Meteo, iNaturalist and the wildflower hotlines need no account, so sunset scoring, meteor showers, whales and blooms all work straight away. The two API keys unlock rare birds and traffic-aware drive times, and can be added later.

data.enable_field_reports: Read the wildflower and autumn colour hotlines

data_description.max_drive_hours: How far you will drive for an event. National park windows ignore this, since those are trips rather than evenings.
data_description.sunset_score: How good a sky has to look before it is worth listing. Raise it if you get too many.
data_description.alert_score: How good anything has to be before the drop-everything sensor turns on.
data_description.ebird_api_key: Free and instant from ebird.org/api/keygen. Without it the bird category simply produces nothing.
data_description.google_api_key: Optional. Without it, drive times come from measured baselines and a calibrated distance estimate.
data_description.enable_field_reports: Scrapes three public pages once a day. Bloom timing depends on winter rainfall and cannot be computed, so these are the only real source for it.
data_description.nps_api_key: Free from nps.gov/subjects/developer. Used to warn you when a road or area in a park you were planning to visit is closed.
